article.title: -느라고 causa negativa/restricción
article.part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태

claims.summary: The NIKL guide records **-느라고** with a reason/result relation and examples such as **수지는 공부하느라고 요즘 정말 바빠요**. It notes that the form commonly occurs in excuse-like contexts. This entry is limited to the documented form and examples rather than a claim that every use has negative polarity.
